what_is_it.heading: What is 5-Amino-1MQ?
what_is_it.body: 5-Amino-1MQ is presented here as an investigational compound within the broader peptide and longevity research landscape. The strongest themes in the available source material involve NNMT activity, NAD+ biology, and metabolic signaling, sleep architecture and circadian signaling, adipose biology and body composition research. This page is designed to give readers a structured research overview while keeping claims grounded, cautious, and source referenced.

items.title: May support reductions in
items.description: May support reductions in fat mass while preserving lean muscle in animal models.

items.title: Associated with elevated NAD+
items.description: Associated with elevated NAD+ levels and SIRT1 activation in preclinical studies.

items.title: Research has explored enhanced
items.description: Research has explored enhanced grip strength observed in aged mice when combined with exercise.

how_it_works.heading: How It Works
how_it_works.body: From the referenced material, 5-Amino-1MQ is best understood through its proposed interaction with NNMT activity, NAD+ biology, and metabolic signaling. Rather than positioning the compound as a guaranteed intervention, the mechanism should be described as a research model that may help explain why scientists are interested in its downstream biological effects.

side_effects.heading: Potential Side Effects
items: Generally well tolerated; occasional reports of mild headache, transient jitteriness, or injection-site reactions.
Long-term human safety data not established; this compound remains investigational.
side_effects.note: This list reflects source-derived observations. Human safety has not been fully established for this investigational compound.

dosing_and_reconstitution.disclaimer: This section is source-derived research information only and is not medical advice or a personal use recommendation.

reconstitution_guide.summary: 10 mg vial, add 2.0 ml bacteriostatic water, yielding 5 mg/ml.
steps: Allow the vial to reach room temperature before preparation.
Add 2.0 mL of bacteriostatic water to the vial.
Gently swirl or roll the vial to mix: do not shake.
The resulting concentration is 5 mg/mL.
Refrigerate after reconstitution and use within the timeframe noted in the storage section.

protocol_duration.summary: Source material indicates a single vial lasts approximately 2-4 days at standard doses.

items.title: Cardiometabolic improvements
items.description: Reductions in blood pressure, LDL cholesterol, waist circumference, and liver fat content (>80% resolution of hepatic steatosis on high doses).

items.title: Universal response
items.description: 100% of participants on 8-12 mg achieved at least 5% weight reduction.
